item.title: Diraq Opens Santa Monica Hub to Expand Silicon Quantum Computing R&D
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – Diraq, the silicon quantum computing pioneer, today announced the opening of its U.S. Technology Hub in Santa Monica, California. The hub brings together a 20-strong multi-disciplinary team with deep expertise in silicon spin qubits, tapping into Southern California’s uniquely deep concentration of quantum talent, and placing Diraq alongside the region’s […]
